name: Bank exploratory feature sensitivity v1
standardization: Each transformed column uses its own full-data mean and population std; all other columns and labels identical
targets: Three distinct posteriors, same Gaussian prior form, not target-preserving reparameterizations
location_construction: 16 independent normalized Gaussian whitened directions plus their negatives, shared across targets; theta=mode+radius*B*direction, B=symmetric inverse sqrt posterior Hessian
stage_a_metrics: Raw/preconditioned residual norm max,q99,q999; exact finite-population noise;29182 share; MC update-noise tail descriptive
stage_b_eligibility: Per variant, at radius sqrt(d), median across directions of max CV2 preconditioned residual norm <= half original and median exact CV2 preconditioned noise <= original. Mechanism screen only, not a statistical test.
stage_b_scope: Only eligible transformed targets plus newly rerun original control. Reference gates unchanged. Separate frozen bounded sampler protocol before stageB.
note: Exploratory protocol frozen before transformed diagnostic computation; no thresholds selected from transformed results
